headline: Man City's Enzo Maresca hails 'complete' Rayan Cherki after Crystal Palace win
description: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca said Rayan Cherki put in a "complete" performance as his double helped them to a commanding 4-1 win at Crystal Palace on Friday evening.

headline: With Cherki and Haaland, Man City can challenge Arsenal in Premier League
description: When Manchester City are clicking, they remain a potent force capable of winning the Premier League -- as Rayan Cherki and Erling Haaland showed Friday.

headline: Manchester City vs. Crystal Palace player ratings as City maintain winning start with emphatic 4-1 victory at Selhurst Park
description: Manchester City continued their winning start to the 2026-27 Premier League season on Friday with a 4-1 victory over Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park.

headline: Leboeuf: Cherki can be 'unstoppable if consistent' at Man City

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Real Madrid eye move for Roma's Koné

headline: Haaland, Cherki braces keep Man City perfect with win over Palace
description: Rayan Cherki's quickfire double inspired Manchester City to a 4-1 victory over Crystal Palace to spoil Pierre Sage's welcome party at Selhurst Park.
